newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG to build $200 mln plants in India.
newsitem.headline: LG to build $200 mln plants in India.

text.p: South Korea's LG Electronics Inc, a unit of the LG Group, said on Monday it planned to invest $200 million by 2000 in building home appliance plants in Uttar Pradesh state in India.
An LG statement that construction had recently started on the plants to make such products as colour TV sets, refrigerators, air conditioners and washing machines.
The plants are due to begin partial operations early next year, with annual capacity of 250,000 TV sets, 120,000 washing machines and 90,000 air conditioners.
Their capacity will later be expanded by the year 2000 to 1.7 million TV sets, 900,000 refrigerators, 450,000 washing machines and 350,000 air conditioners.
The company expects annual sales from the Indian plants to reach $80 million in 1998, rising to $300 million in 2000 and to $1.6 billion in 2005.
